serverInfo.name: tossinbox
serverInfo.title: TossInbox
serverInfo.description: Disposable email inboxes for AI agents: create inboxes, list and read messages, wait for verification (OTP) codes.

instructions: Typical flow: create_inbox -> submit the returned address in the signup form -> wait_for_code -> finish the signup with the code -> remove the inbox from the shell with `tossinbox toss`. Receive-only: TossInbox never sends email.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a fresh disposable email inbox. Returns its address and the upstream provider name.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List the messages currently sitting in a TossInbox inbox.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read a full message body, including any automatically detected verification code.

tools.name: wait_for_code
tools.description: Block until a message arrives in the inbox and return its extracted verification (OTP) code.
